##### Project general facts

Fairway Villas by Emaar Properties is a residential development in Emaar South, Dubai, offering three- and four-bedroom villas designed for modern family living. The residences feature spacious layouts, contemporary architecture, and views of the surrounding golf course, combining privacy and comfort with a landscaped residential setting.

The community offers a range of recreational amenities, including an 18-hole championship golf course, a golf clubhouse, swimming pools for adults and children, a linear park, a children's play area, a multipurpose room, and a jogging path. These facilities provide opportunities for fitness, outdoor activities, and family leisure.

The villas feature elegant finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and interiors designed to maximise natural light and create a sense of space. The layouts combine functional living areas with outdoor spaces, while the contemporary architectural style complements the surrounding greenery and golf course views.

##### Location description and benefits

Fairway Villas is located in Emaar South, a residential community within Dubai South, known for its golf course, landscaped green spaces, and modern residential developments. The area offers a quieter alternative to central Dubai while providing access to everyday amenities and recreational facilities.

Emaar South features parks, retail outlets, dining options, and other community facilities. Expo City Dubai is also nearby, adding access to business, exhibition, and lifestyle destinations. The area's golf-oriented environment and open green spaces contribute to its appeal for families and residents seeking an active lifestyle.

The community benefits from road connections to other parts of Dubai and the surrounding areas. Al Maktoum International Airport and Dubai South's business and logistics district are key nearby destinations, making the location convenient for residents working in the area or travelling regularly.
